limitations: This is complete finite-population descriptive reporting, not six-family confirmation, a confidence interval, model ranking or G-SIGNAL.
The three families reuse eight source-polynomial clusters. Three requests per task and two model cells do not create additional independent mathematical tasks.
All retained labels are correct, but this review does not qualitatively certify any of the 432 correct explanations; an empty failure queue is not proof of correct explanations.
Private pre-publication RunViews have publishedAt:null; public views retain actual timestamps. Their RunRecord bodies are equal, but their whole-view hashes are deliberately distinct.
The original 11 unknown frontier remote outcomes remain unknown. Zero observed wrong labels does not establish universal absence of actual errors.
This review is AI-assisted and supplies no human approval. Frontend checks run production projection/export code offline and do not assert browser visual or accessibility verification.
Provider costs are unreported. Output-token totals include reported reasoning tokens, which must not be added again.
Later supplement or conditional-reserve decisions remain separate populations and prospective gates; this review does not activate them.
